svg.text: BNO055 breakout → General Driver, connector P1 “IIC”
Plan B bench accelerometer (issue #73). Four wires. Do NOT use the 40-pin header: on this board its pins 1 and 3 are 5 V.
Where it is: front of the board, under the ESP32 module,
right of the LiDAR connector. Silkscreen beside it, top to bottom:
Match by the PRINTED NAMES on each board, not by position.
• Before plugging in: with the board powered, P1 3V3 to GND must read about 3.3 V on a meter.
• VIN accepts 3.3 V. ADR left open sets the I²C address to 0x28 (no clash with the board's 0x0C/0x42/0x6B/0x77).
• P1 looks like the LiDAR port (2.0 mm pitch PH-type, unverified): a PH2.0 4-pin lead, or wires soldered to its pads.
• Glue the breakout flat near the fork tip; tie the 4 wires to the fork near the hub with a slack loop (it swings 90°).
• Then the bench command “imu scan” must list 0x28 "BNO055 (bench accelerometer)".
